result.title: High-Fidelity Image Matting with Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
result.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/
result.summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for image matting by transferring generative priors learned from large-scale pretraining. However, existing approaches largely rely on latent diffusion models, whose compressed representations and VAE-based reconstruction introduce a mismatch with the high-frequency precision required for matting. We present PixelMatte, a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for high-fidelity image matting. We show that strong image-conditioned matting capabilities can be acquired even from a pure text-to-image model without paired image-to-image pretraining. Our approach reuses the backbone's native patch embedding to jointly process the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte as spatially aligned tokens, enabling direct pixel-space prediction without additional condition encoders or adapters. With pixel-accurate synthetic supervision and real-image fine-tuning, PixelMatte predicts alpha mattes in a single forward pass. Two lightweight calibration modules, LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner, further improve regional opacity accuracy and boundary fidelity. Experiments across four benchmarks and two distinct pixel diffusion backbones demonstrate substantial improvements over existing methods, reducing SAD and gradient errors by 24-44% relative to RenderMatte on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, while achieving competitive performance on AIM-500 and RenderMatte-2K. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pixel-space generative priors for precision-sensitive image matting. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PixelMatte，将预训练像素空间扩散 Transformer 改造为单次前向完成图像抠图的框架：复用骨干原生 patch embedding 把输入图像、trimap 与噪声 alpha 作为空间对齐 token 联合处理，并加 LayerShift 与 High-Pass Refiner 两个轻量校准模块提升区域透明度与边缘精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩 latent 与高频细节需求不匹配、改用像素空间表示」的论证及原生 patch token 直接注入视觉条件的做法，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否在 latent 状态里坍缩、以及如何无损注入视觉证据。
